name: Calming tablets
镇静药
description: 暂时缓解压力，同时使人困倦。

name: Sleeping tablets
助眠药
description: Helps with troubled sleep. Does not prevent every nightmare.
帮助入睡，不保证阻止所有噩梦。

name: Wakefulness tablets
提神药
description: Temporarily masks fatigue. Fatigue returns when it wears off.
暂时压低疲劳，药效消退后疲劳会回升。

name: Concentration tablets
专注药
description: Improves gains from studying while active. Causes tension.
药效期间提高实际学习收益，同时增加压力。

name: Soothing tablets
安神药
description: Temporarily eases the burden of trauma. Does not erase memories.
暂时减轻创伤负担，不抹去经历。
